# routeros_ip_firewall_service_port (Resource)
Settings of one entry of `/ip firewall service-port` (connection tracking helpers). The entries are built into RouterOS: creating the resource changes the existing entry, deleting it only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage
```terraform
# The entries are built into RouterOS; the resource only changes them.
resource "routeros_ip_firewall_service_port" "sip" {
  name     = "sip"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the helper (`ftp`, `tftp`, `irc`, `h323`, `sip`, `pptp`, `rtsp`, `udplite`, `dccp`, `sctp`). The entry must exist on the router.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ports` (Set of Number) Ports the helper listens on (only for helpers that have ports).
- `sip_direct_media` (Boolean) SIP: allow media streams directly between the endpoints.
- `sip_timeout` (String) SIP: timeout of the SIP connection tracking entries.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invalid` (Boolean) RouterOS marks the helper invalid (`I` flag).

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/firewall/service-port get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ip_firewall_service_port.sip "*5"
#Or you can import a resource using one of its attributes
terraform import routeros_ip_firewall_service_port.sip "name=sip"
```
